lines: This is Mativy and Marichka for your Evening News.
For our new developments: Aijinkova has started importing Londish cars.

Many officials have mixed opinions on the new partnership between Aijinkova and Londinyy—our sources from inside the People's Government report concerns over the country overextending itself so soon after the Aijin Civil War.
Others are enthusiastic about the country building new and strong foreign connections.
As of now, it appears to be a solid morale booster for anyone with the funds to travel cross-country a little faster.
That's a light way of putting it, Mativy.
The Verehn Railway Station, centered in its now quarantined namesake, was a stopping point for about 80% of the railway lines in the nation.
Because of all the construction needed to reroute some of those lines, people need a new way to traverse the country.
I think you just want a new car.
Your taillights are in the shape of the Londinyy flag.
In other news, Marichka's been following my car around.
Breaking news: a young man reporting from an undisclosed location has just died from unknown causes.
I advise our listeners to watch their mouths around their coworkers, for their own safety.
